text:
Predicates:
HasEndowment(x, y) ::: x has an endowment valued at y.
LargestEndowment(x) ::: x has the largest endowment among educational institutions.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college.
School(x) ::: x is a school.
AtLocation(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to y in year y.
ValuedAt(x, y) ::: x is valued at y.
Question:
Yale University has the largest university endowment of any educational institution.
Premises:
YaleUniversity ∧ MovedTo(YaleUniversity, NewHaven) ∧ ValuedAt(YaleUniversity, 42.3 billion) ∧ Organize(YaleUniversity, 27) ∧ ResidentialCollege(BenjaminFranklinCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(BerkeleyCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(BranfordCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(DavenportCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(EzraStilesCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(GraceHopperCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(JonathanEdwardsCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(MorseCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(PauliMurrayCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(PiersonCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(SaybrookCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(SillimanCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(TimothyDwightCollege) ∧ ResidentialCollege(TrumbullCollege) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university that moved to New Haven in 1716, with an endowment valued at $42.3 billion, organized into 27 colleges including residential colleges and professional schools, and has multiple residential colleges.
Conclusion:
LargestEndowment(YaleUniversity) ::: Yale University has the largest university endowment of any educational institution.
